# Theory: HPA Owns Replicas; Canary Steps Also Own Replicas

Two controllers cannot both own `spec.replicas` without a rule. `setCanaryScale` and traffic-based splits exist to stop HPA from shrinking the canary out of existence.

## Invariants

1. Replica-based canary + HPA on the Rollout is the subtle bug.
2. Traffic-based canary lets HPA scale the whole set more safely.
3. Metrics-server must exist for HPA to do anything.

```text
HPA  --replicas-->  Rollout  <-- canary step replica math
```

## What can break

- HPA on both stable and canary Deployments independently.

## How to read this chapter

The problem, metrics, `setCanaryScale`.
